audit.why: TRICKY / 7-10 fits a 48.11% win rate over 1856 games — a lane you own until one 120s ultimate resolves it.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with itself in TWO rows and the whys under them argued the opposite of the verdict shown.
audit.why: Row 4 (Level 6): phases[4].side said Zed but win[4] said Aurora, and phases[4].why described Aurora's zone re-pricing fights. Row 5 (First item): phases[5].side said 'Skill' while win[5] said Zed. Both content-layer prose (mid: 'the second Zed hits Level 6 the entire dynamic flips') and whys[4]/whys[5] agree that 6 belongs to Zed and first item returns to Aurora, so the chart is fixed to that in both layers with the whys rewritten to match.
audit.corrected: Row 4 -> Zed on both layers with a Death Mark why; row 5 -> Aurora on both layers with a Luden's-vs-120s why.

audit.why: Death Mark's untargetable dash, the 3-second damage-repeat mark, Living Shadow's 20s/650 swap and Shadow Slash's 290 range are all stated and all match Riot's text. The untargetable-dodges-burst interaction is already covered in report[5].

edits.after: Luden's spike against a 120s Death Mark: the full Q-E-Q rotation chunks him between his ult windows.

edits.before: Post-6, fight where you dropped the zone: the speed differential turns even skirmishes into chases you win both directions.

notes: This matchup carried a genuine cross-layer level-chart disagreement in two rows (phases[4].side Zed vs win[4] Aurora; phases[5].side 'Skill' vs win[5] Zed) and both rows' whys argued against their own verdict. Fixed as one atomic group in both layers, resolved in favour of the prose on both layers, which agrees that Level 6 flips to Zed and first item returns to Aurora. NOTE: packet.levelChart disagrees with that resolution — it reads Aurora at row 4 and Zed at row 5, i.e. off by one against every prose field on the page. I went with the prose; if the packet chart is the intended authority these two rows should be swapped instead. packet.defects flags "Death Mark's" in whys[6] as a probable wrong ability name — FALSE POSITIVE, it is a possessive of the real R name, and whys[6] no longer contains that phrase anyway.
